Overview

PitchBook’s API solution allows you to call specific PitchBook data into your internal business systems on demand. This flexible solution means you have access to PitchBook’s expansive database. It’s the ideal integration for CRM enrichment, allowing you to extract data on an ad-hoc basis that meets the needs of your organization.

You can explore a specific entity and retrieve valuable data, and the API solution enables you to apply specific criteria, such as location and industry, to drill down into the businesses you discover.\


### Not a PitchBook customer?

[Request free trial](http://pitchbook.com/free-trial)

Use cases

The API is a good solution if:\


- Your scope and data points are subject to change frequently.
- You require a near-instant population of data.
- You perform ad-hoc research.
- You want to see past and present financial data.
- RESTful API is a system requirement.

### Ready to get started?

How the API works

**Accessing the API**\
The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser. Every call will use the same base URL: [https://api.pitchbook.com](https://api.pitchbook.com)

**Available data points**\
The API solution offers a variety of relational endpoints, including financing details, deal stock information, as well as AI-powered VC exit predictor data. See the full list from our [API Endpoints Overview document.](https://pitchbook.highspot.com/items/5f8418238117171c01abc054?lfrm=srp.1#1)

**Create your API connection**\
To start your API connection, you will need to send a request directly to our Direct Data team [through this link.](https://pitchbook.com/products/direct-access-data?utm_source=google\&utm_medium=cpc\&utm_campaign=ROAST-Search-Brand-CentralEurope\&adgroup=\&utm_term=pitchbook\&device=c\&utm_content=&_bk=pitchbook&_bt=692687660336&_bm=e&_bn=g&_bg=159619233076\&kwdaud=kwd-334479000139\&sfid=-dc_pcrid_692687660336_pkw_pitchbook_pmt_e_slid__productid__pgrid_159619233076_ptaid_kwd-334479000139\&gad_source=1\&gbraid=0AAAAA9Xh_EaUNnreAs7FvuEymUQuWzBgU\&gclid=CjwKCAjwktO_BhBrEiwAV70jXnWu1Xhd80_LMs-DIblUDGS_QRb1P1qKPKKGvKjtmcWtuiKdcPbrXxoC3ssQAvD_BwE)

Or if you’re a PitchBook client, you can also head to the Plugins & Apps section from the My PitchBook section of the left-hand sidebar on the PitchBook Platform and choose PitchBook API.

From this section on the platform, you can test specific endpoints. This section on PitchBook also allows you to reach out to our Direct Data team to request access to the API.

Overview

Single sign-on (SSO) for PitchBook lets your organization use one set of corporate credentials to log in to multiple applications efficiently and securely. Enabling SSO for PitchBook offers several benefits:\


- **Authentication control:** In an “SSO Mandatory” configuration, you can control individual user authentication directly. This allows you to easily manage user accounts, access, and permissions.
- **On-demand provisioning:** Just-in-time (JIT) auto-provisioning allows PitchBook user accounts to be created automatically at login, taking the manual labor out of managing user access to each individual application.
- **Company credentialing:** Utilizing company authentication means one less set of credentials to remember and maintain, reducing the likelihood of repeated and less secure passwords.

SSO relies on two primary contributors, Service Provider (SP) metadata and Identity Provider (IdP) metadata, to create an authenticated and secure login to the applications you need. Both SP and IdP requests are supported by the PitchBook SSO integration and can be configured using Security Assertion Markup Language 2.0 (SAML 2.0) via your IdP. Examples of IdP providers include Okta, Microsoft Entra, and OneLogin.

Authentication via SSO is supported across our web platform, mobile application, Excel Plugin, and Chrome Extension.

\
Getting started

Enabling SSO for your organization is a collaborative process between your team and PitchBook. Most new setups are completed through our self-service SSO portal, with help from our Technical Support team. Please note that university accounts aren’t eligible for self-service setup and are configured by our Support team instead. To get started, reach out to our Support team at support\@pitchbook.com.



**Before you begin**

Once you’ve contacted Support, we’ll grant portal access to the person configuring SSO on your side. To use the self-service portal, have the following ready:

- The name and email address of the person responsible for completing SSO setup on your side (this person needs admin access to your identity provider, typically someone on your IT team). Let us know whether this person will also handle testing, or whether a separate testing contact should be included.
- An identity provider that supports SAML 2.0, such as Okta, Microsoft Entra, or OneLogin.
- The list of email domains your organization will use for SSO.
- Your identity provider configuration details. See the IdP configuration section below for the exact attributes required.

IdP configuration

To complete your SSO connection, set up a custom enterprise application on your identity provider (IdP). This generates the IdP metadata PitchBook needs to establish the connection. You can download PitchBook’s service provider details, including ACS URL and SP Entity ID, directly in the SSO portal.

The exact steps for IdP configuration will vary depending on the provider, but the following configurations must be made before testing your SSO connection with PitchBook:

- **Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL:** See provided metadata in the SSO portal
- **SP Entity ID:** See provided metadata in the SSO portal
- **SP** **Entity Name:** PitchBook Platform
- **Assertion Signature Required:** true
- **Binding:** urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST
- **Name ID:** Email address (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress) format that returns the email address to log in to PitchBook
- **Email Address attribute:** “Email” required for configuration provided in the SSO portal

For University account configurations:\


- **eduPersonAffiliation attribute:** Requested for all University account configurations. This attribute must identify each user as a student or faculty (or your provider’s equivalent value).



Once your enterprise application is created and configured, upload your IdP metadata (an XML file exported from your provider, including your login URL and signing certificate) in the SSO portal to complete the connection.



**Grant SSO permissions to your users**

After configuration is complete, the person responsible for completing SSO setup on your side must grant SSO permissions to your users, either by enabling all licensed PitchBook users or by creating a user group. Users cannot log in via SSO until this step is done.\

Overview

As we rely on AI tools to move faster and make smarter decisions, switching between tools to find data can be time-consuming. PitchBook’s Premium Connector solves this by integrating PitchBook data directly into the AI platforms you already use. With secure access, you can query private market insights without disrupting workflow. In this article, learn how our Premium Connector works and which AI platforms we partner with.

### Not a PitchBook customer?

[Request free trial](http://pitchbook.com/free-trial)

How it works

The Premium Connector provides a secure link between PitchBook and AI tools. Once connected, you can use your AI tool to access a wide range of PitchBook’s private market data directly. By specifying **“**Using PitchBook data as the source**”** in your query, you ensure the response includes only PitchBook’s verified proprietary data.

When a question is sent, the connector translates it into a query that PitchBook can process. It then retrieves the relevant information, formats it, and sends it back to the AI tool. This workflow ensures that data is delivered accurately and only according to the permissions assigned to each user.

Usage

With Premium Connector access, you get:

- 150 tool calls per hour – In any 60-minute window, you can make up to 150 individual requests to pull PitchBook data.
- 300 tool calls per day – Across a full 24-hour period, you have 300 total requests to pull PitchBook data.

### Ready to get started?

[Log in](http://my.pitchbook.com/)

Workflow

This section outlines the general workflow for using the Premium Connector. While setup may vary slightly across different AI partners, the core process follows these steps:



- **Setup** – AI partners connect securely to PitchBook’s Premium Connector (built on MCP server technology) directly through the partner’s site. There’s no need for local installation or custom integration as the connection is managed in the cloud, allowing quick deployment.\

- **Authenticate via SSO** – Only licensed PitchBook users can access the connector. Authentication happens through single sign-on (SSO), ensuring that access is secure and tied to each user’s permissions. Additional application-level safeguards ensure that only approved AI platforms, such as authorized enterprise accounts, can interact with PitchBook data. For instructions on enabling SSO, see [Getting started with single sign-on (SSO)](https://pitchbook.com/help/getting-started-with-single-sign-on-sso).
- **Use **–** **Once connected, you can query PitchBook data directly within their AI tool. Common use cases include company research, deal sourcing, fundraising analysis, and benchmarking comparable companies.
